incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: AUTH-JWT-VALIDATION-5001 - spike in jwt validation failures (all regions)

pagerduty: Trigger details - 50% auth request failure rate across api-gateway, prompt-router, embeddings-proxy. Escalation: oncall @mira.

mira: ack - I'm on it, paging folks. Jumping in with logs.

mira: quick summary: starting ~12:04 UTC we see verifier failing with `invalid_kid` and `no matching key found` across services. Error rate climbs rapidly.

alex: saw the same in infra metrics. CPU fine, but error counts explode on the auth middleware.

mira: logs snippet from prompt-router (last 30s):
```
ERROR auth: token validation failed: kid mismatch: expected kid 'jwks-main-2025-09', got 'jwks-rotate-2026-01'
request_id=abc123 path=/v1/chat model=gpt-4-internal
```

sam: were we rolling a key rotation job this morning? I remember a PR for automated key rotation merged yesterday.

irene: yes, PR #3426 deployed at 11:45 UTC. It flipped the signer to emit new KID and updated jwks endpoint. Verifier config was supposed to pick up multiple keys but might not have.

mira: hypothesis: deploy created a short window where new signer KID was used but verifier caches old JWKS or the env JWKS_URL points to the wrong bucket. Confirming JWKS fetch errors:
```
WARN auth: failed to refresh jwks: 403 forbidden fetching https://auth-jwks.redwood.internal/keys.json
```

mira: paging ops-runner for network/permission checks. @ops-runner can you confirm the service role for jwks fetch?

ops-runner: looking. IAM role for verifier changed in the release job (saw in deploy logs). It didn't get attached to the new verifier instances in us-west-2. Investigating.

sam: if verifiers can't fetch the new jwks, they'll reject tokens signed with the new key. Two immediate mitigations: 1) revert signer to previous key, 2) allow verifier to accept both keys by loading cached JWKS from S3. Which is faster?

alex: revert signer is fastest — rollback the deploy that flipped the signer KID (global config flag `AUTH_ACTIVE_KID`). We can flip that flag in param store and restart signer pods.

mira: doing controlled rollback: flipping `AUTH_ACTIVE_KID` -> `jwks-main-2025-09` in parameter store now.

mira: executed: `aws ssm put-parameter --name /auth/AUTH_ACTIVE_KID --value jwks-main-2025-09 --overwrite`

mira: also restarting signer deployment in us-east-1 and us-west-2: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-signer -n redwood-auth`

irene: rolling restarts started. Can we temporarily relax strict validation for internal routes to reduce customer impact? We should be careful.

sam: propose a short-lived mitigation: set `ENFORCE_JWT_VALIDATION=partial` on internal-only routes so we allow tokens if header present and fallback to legacy session cookie for internal service-to-service calls. This is risky but reduces 5xx impact.

mira: I pushed a canary to proxy in us-east-1 with `ENFORCE_JWT_VALIDATION=partial` for internal routes only. Monitoring errors.

(5m passes)

mira: errors dropping from 50% -> 8% in canary region. Rolling `partial` to remaining regions for internal path prefix `/internal/*`. Public external customer traffic still requires full validation.

irene: ops-runner reports IAM role fix is applied; verifiers can fetch JWKS again. They're successfully fetching both keys now.

ops-runner: `curl -sS https://auth-jwks.redwood.internal/keys.json | jq '.keys[].kid'` returns ["jwks-main-2025-09","jwks-rotate-2026-01"]

mira: great — now we need to ensure verifiers accept multiple keys. Patch rolling out to verifiers to treat JWKS list as acceptable if kid matches any. (hotfix branch `verifier/jwks-multi-kid`).

alex: rolling verifier hotfix as a canary, will deploy to 10% first. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/verifier verifier=ghcr.io/redwood/verifier:hotfix-jwks-multi-kid`

sam: after canary looks good (5m), schedule full rollout. Also revert `ENFORCE_JWT_VALIDATION` back to `strict` after verifiers accept both keys.

(10m pass)

mira: canary verifier healthy. Error rate across services trending back to normal ~0.4%. Proceeding to full rollout.

alex: full rollout completed. Verifiers are accepting both kids. Signer rollback finished earlier and signer is now issuing previous kid again.

mira: reverting internal partial enforcement -> setting `ENFORCE_JWT_VALIDATION=strict` for all regions.

mira: service metrics show auth 5xxs returned to baseline. Customer incident impact: temporary 5xx errors for some customers between 12:04-12:20 UTC, mostly affecting calls that used newly minted tokens during rotation window.

irene: creating incident ticket to add to postmortem: root cause = race between signer deploy and verifier IAM role/cached JWKS. Contributing factors: automated key-rotate PR lacked a rollout guard and missing integration test for verifier JWKS refresh behavior.

sam: action items assigned:
- alex: update deploy job to ensure IAM role attachment completes before signer rollout (PR by EOD).
- irene: add JWKS refresh integration test to CI (PR by tomorrow).
- mira: write postmortem draft and customer communication, include timeline + affected customers list (first draft in 6 hours).
- ops-runner: audit other services for similar IAM role drift (report in 24h).

mira: handing off to sam for the remainder of the on-call shift at 12:45 UTC. Sam, please monitor the next 2 hours and post any anomalies here.

sam: taking over. Noted. I'll keep watch and update if anything else pops.

incident-bot: Incident AUTH-JWT-VALIDATION-5001 marked RESOLVED by mira at 12:41 UTC. Duration ~37 minutes.

mira: thanks everyone for the quick responses. Postmortem will be thorough. :heart:
